name: com.macproof/macproof
title: MacProof
description: Search indie Mac apps with checked facts: signature, notarization, malware scan, real prices.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search MacProof, a marketplace of indie Mac apps sold from the maker's own site, each one opened and checked (code signature, Apple notarization, malware scan). Filter by category, price model, price ceiling and checks. Returns apps with their checked facts.

query.description: Words to match against names, one-line summaries and search phrases. Optional when filters are given.

category.description: One of: productivity, utilities, developer-tools, design, writing, video-audio, menu-bar, window-management, ai-tools, files-cloud, security-privacy, notes, photo, music, system-tools, finance.

max_price.description: Highest price, in the app's own currency units (29 means 29.00).

notarized_only.description: Only apps Apple has notarized, as confirmed by MacProof's scan.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: recommend_apps
tools.description: Describe in plain words what the person needs ("notes app, no subscription, files stay on my disk") and get the best-fitting listed apps, with the facts to justify a recommendation: price terms, who signed it, notarization, malware check, rating and verified sales.

need.description: What the person needs, in their own words.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 8. Default 5.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Indie Mac alternatives to a named app (for example "Obsidian", "Notion", "Magnet"), whether or not that app is listed on MacProof. Returns similar listed apps and how they compare on price and checks.

to.description: The app to find alternatives to.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 8. Default 5.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Everything MacProof holds about one app: what it does, price terms (trial, refunds, devices, updates), the full proof report from our own scan (signer, team id, notarization, malware result, sandbox, architectures, minimum macOS, file fingerprint), rating, the maker, and where to buy or try it.

slug.description: The app's slug, as returned by the other tools (for example "inkwell").

tools.name: verify_download
tools.description: Checks a downloaded Mac app file against MacProof's records. Give the file's SHA-256 fingerprint (run `shasum -a 256 file.dmg`) or the download link. Says whether it is exactly the file MacProof checked, for which app and version, who signed it, and whether it was notarized and clean. Reads only MacProof's own records; documented at https://macproof.com/agents.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the .dmg or .zip, 64 hex characters.

url.description: The direct download link, if you do not have the file.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Reviews of one app from MacProof accounts, each read by a person before publishing. "bought_it" is true only when the reviewer's purchase was confirmed against the maker's payment records.

tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: The MacProof charts. "week" and "month" rank by verified sales read from makers' payment providers, then votes; "today" is today's launches by votes. Nobody can pay for a place.

category.description: Optional. One of: productivity, utilities, developer-tools, design, writing, video-audio, menu-bar, window-management, ai-tools, files-cloud, security-privacy, notes, photo, music, system-tools, finance.

tools.name: todays_launches
tools.description: The indie Mac apps launching on MacProof today (the day runs midnight to midnight UTC) and the current app of the day.
